formattedAddress: No. 145號, Rui'an St, Longsheng Village, Da’an District, Taipei City, Taiwan 106

text.text: Their yellow exterior caught my eye. I tried their bacon with burger patties, scrambled egg, fries, cherry tomatoes, and mushrooms. It tasted great. I appreciate that their ketchup was freshly served and not from a bottle. I wasn’t a fan of mushrooms, but this meal definitely satiated my hunger.

text.text:
I’ve never been to the Diner 瑞安店 in person, but it has become one of my favorite places to order from on UberEats. When I’m craving a real American breakfast in Taipei, this is the first place I turn to.

The food arrives consistently fresh, hot, and well-prepared, which isn’t always the case with delivery. My absolute favorite is the 地中海蛋捲 Mediterranean Omelette — flavorful, satisfying, and packed with just the right balance of ingredients. I also really enjoy their Potatoes O’Brien, which are cooked perfectly with that mix of crispy edges and soft, flavorful bites.

What I appreciate most is the consistency: every time I order, the quality is the same — generous portions, delicious flavors, and a comforting taste of home-style breakfast. Even through delivery, the food never feels rushed or sloppy; it feels like care goes into every order.

For anyone looking for hearty, reliable, and genuinely tasty American-style breakfasts in Taipei, the Diner 瑞安店 is my go-to recommendation.

text.text: This is where Diner begins.  Being a long supporter of Diner, this has been one of my favourite burger place.  I did not order burger in this visit.  In stead, I ordered ribs and other side dishes.  Among these, nacho is the most satisfying treat, and rib is not.   I would recommend to stick to other brunch items like burger, sandwich, eggs.

text.text: It's so hard to find genuine tasting American breakfast food in Taipei. This place actually does it well. I liked it so much that after discovering it I went back again the next day for a meeting.
